project_title: SustainRepo ESG Platform - OCR & Dashboard Enhancements Design Blueprint

scale.h1: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-heading font-bold text-text-primary tracking-tight
scale.h2: text-xl sm:text-2xl font-heading font-semibold text-text-primary tracking-tight
scale.label: text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wider text-text-muted

think_mode.name: Think Mode (OpenAI GPT-5.5)
think_mode.description: Deep multi-pass reasoning for complex, multi-page, or ambiguous invoices & spreadsheets

fast_mode.name: Fast Mode (Anthropic Claude Sonnet 4.6 + Haiku 4.5)
fast_mode.description: Sub-second rapid extraction & automated Scope 1/2/3 classification workflow

ocr_module_specifications.naics_mapping: Automated Scope 3 NAICS sector identification & spend factor alignment
line_item_workflow: Accept Line Item → Emission Form Pre-fill

component_guidelines.buttons: Use Shadcn Button component with explicit hover text colors and data-testid tags. Primary action uses bg-[#1A4D2E] hover:bg-[#143D24] text-white.
component_guidelines.cards: Use Shadcn Card with rounded-xl border border-slate-200/80 bg-white shadow-sm. Internal padding p-5 sm:p-6.
component_guidelines.tables: Use Shadcn Table with hover:bg-slate-50/80, sticky header for scrolling, and clear visual status indicators.
component_guidelines.dialogs: Use Shadcn Dialog for Edit Line Item and Accept Confirmation. Must be accessible with keyboard focus trap.
component_guidelines.toasts: Use Sonner toast notifications for feedback on file upload, edit save, acceptance, and exports.

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_convention: All interactive and key status components MUST include data-testid attribute in kebab-case.
accessibility_and_testing.contrast_standard: All text elements meet WCAG AA (minimum 4.5:1 ratio) against surface backgrounds.
accessibility_and_testing.keyboard_nav: Full tab index support across tabs, file dropzones, table action buttons, and modal dialogs.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all OCR components are modular, cleanly structured, and importable without circular dependencies.
Maintain complete compatibility with existing AuthContext, OCRContext, and API routing.
Preserve prefill behavior when navigating from accepted line item into GHG Scope 1/2/3 emission forms.
Do not break existing dashboard routes or unrelated module files.
Always include data-testid on every interactive button, input, tab, select, and status badge.
